newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Denmark airport shrs to outperform -bank.
newsitem.headline: Denmark airport shrs to outperform -bank.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Lehman Brothers said it was holding its "outperform" rating on shares in Copenhagen Airports because of its impressive traffic growth and a charging structure which will ensure this continues.

In a market research report dated November 14 but received by Reuters on Friday, Lehman Brothers said the airport's stocks have performed well since the airport was privatised and expected this to continue.
"The stock has performed well since privatisation, but we believe that it will continue to surprise on the upside with its earnings and we continue to rate the stock 2 (Outperform)."
The airport's aggressive campaign to promote itself as a gateway to Scandinavia was fuelling growth, said the report, called "European Airlines & Airports."
A payment system in which transfer passengers pay less than other travellers flying point-to-point would continue to boost traffic growth, it said.
"Traffic is also growing at an impressive rate, up eight percent so far in 1996.

"A differential charging structure is in place to charge less for transit and transfer passenger than for point to point passengers and this we believe will help sustain above average traffic growth at the airport."
